title.rendered: Arqaam Capital wins “Best Sukuk Strategy 3 Years” at Global Banking & Markets Awards

content.rendered:
We’re incredibly proud to announce that Arqaam Capital’s Fixed Income Asset Management team has won the “Best Sukuk Strategy 3 Years” award from Global Banking & Markets*

Winning an award for longer term performance is a testament to the veracity of our process. 

Over the past 16 years that our CIO Abdul Kadir Hussain, CFA has operated in this space he and his teams have been recognized multiple times, and we are happy and proud to add another award to the stable 

This reward is also a result of:

A Dedicated Team: Committed to achieving the best for our investors in the Sukuk market.

A huge congratulations to our core team: 

Mehdi POPOTTE, CFA

Nadim Amatouri, CFA

Jad Elrayess

Hayssam Sabra

Fady Gendy, CFA

Gayatri Banga

Biju Das

 

This win reaffirms our commitment to excellence in the Sukuk space! Thank you to our team and our investors.
